body_long:
Al Habtoor Grand Resort, Autograph Collection, in Dubai has appointed Christophe Delabarre as hotel manager. The resort says the appointment strengthens its senior leadership as it enters a new phase of growth.

The beachfront resort is part of Marriott International's Autograph Collection, a brand of more than 200 independent hotels in over 30 countries and territories. It was the brand's first hotel in the Middle East when it joined in 2015.

## Twenty years across three regions

Christophe Delabarre brings more than 20 years of international hospitality experience in Europe, Asia and the Middle East. He has held leadership roles with IHG, Marriott, Hilton, Mandarin Oriental and Disneyland Paris, building a record in improving operational performance, creating restaurant and guest experience concepts, and building teams.

At Al Habtoor Grand Resort he will oversee daily operations and strategic improvements. His priorities are rooms and food and beverage performance, new revenue streams, the guest journey, talent development and team culture.

## The signal

Dubai's hotels are preparing for the winter season after a quieter summer. Accor reported UAE RevPAR down about 20% in the third quarter, though improving on the second. Resorts that strengthen their operations now, with a focus on food and beverage and new revenue sources, will be best placed when demand returns in full.

Congratulations to Christophe Delabarre on his appointment.
summary: Christophe Delabarre joins Al Habtoor Grand Resort, Autograph Collection, as Hotel Manager. He brings more than 20 years with groups including IHG, Marriott, Hilton, Mandarin Oriental and Disneyland Paris.
